articleTitle: Decision Making and Learning in Wagon-Repairing
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider production management using such elements of artificial intelligence as human-machine learning and decision-making procedures with fuzzy or qualitative guidelines. These mechanisms include heuristic elements, and use the knowledge of decision-makers and experts, their language, and the rules formulated in this language. The problem of the control mechanism optimal synthesis, with the guidelines of the expert, is set. This mechanism models the functions of people in conditions of uncertainty. The obtained optimal control mechanism includes learning and stimulation procedures. The proved theorem offers a solution to the problem of optimal synthesis of the learning mechanism using the dichotomous classification procedure, supported by an iterative pattern recognition procedure. This iterative procedure uses both a formal recursive algorithm and the results of recognition by an expert on images of emerging situations. As a result, adaptive norms are formed to evaluate the effectiveness and stimulate production. The use of the optimal control mechanism illustrates by the example of the wagon-repair production of a large-scale corporation Russian Railways.

articleTitle: Efficiency of Neural Networks in Forecasting Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Forecasting financial market trends is one of the most important tasks for investors. Traditional methods are complemented by machine learning methods, the potential of which is to find hidden knowledge in large amounts of information. Nonlinear models and methods based on artificial intelligence (neural networks) are considered. Currently, the real use of neural networks is developing in the following areas: stock exchange and macroeconomic forecasting; speech recognition and dialogue with the person; imitation of intellectual activity; improvement of poor-quality and noisy information; identification of suspicious persons and situations. In this paper it will be shown about the effective use of neural networks in forecasting problems.

articleTitle: The Design Concept of Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: According to the article, the modeling process of every digital twin can be divided into three stages: the development of SysML (The Systems Modeling Language) diagrams, the use of AnyLogic as a tool for simulation modeling, and the use of MES (Manufacturing Execution System) for communication with production systems. Also, it is suggested to evaluate the efficiency of a digital production process using two numerical indicators: the OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) coefficient, the MCE (Manufacturing Cycle Effectiveness) coefficient.

articleTitle: A Digital Approach to Aircraft Product Lifecycle Management
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In the offered work the basic positions of the conception of management of product life cycle with reference to difficult aircraft building objects are formulated, the functional scheme of a uniform information space is offered, and the structure of the technologies applicable for its realisation is analyzed.

articleTitle: Development of Infrastructure in Siberia, the Far East and the Arctic zone of Russia
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The scientific and technical infrastructural aspects of substantiating the conditions for the deeply integrated development of Siberia, the Far East, and the Arctic zone of Russia are considered. Such development is based on the creation of transport and logistics corridors between Europe and Asia on the basis of the Northern Sea Route, as well as the Trans-Siberian and Baikal-Amur railways. In these corridors should be located multimodal terminal and logistics centers. These centers should be integrated into the transport infrastructure of Siberia, the Far East, and the Arctic zone of Russia. To this end, rail, road, air, and inland water transport links between the Northern Sea Route and the indicated highways should be organized. The conditions for the coordinated development of transport, energy, information, and telecommunications infrastructure of Siberia, the Far East, and the Arctic are defined. A set of tasks for the development of this complex infrastructure is considered. Models and methods have been developed for solving these problems using the apparatus of the theory of large-scale transport systems. They include models and methods for constructing transport corridors, clustering of large-scale networks, integrated assessment, and ranking of complex projects and energy efficiency. The developed models and methods were used to develop plans for the development of the complex infrastructure of Siberia, the Far East, and the Arctic zone of Russia for the period until 2050.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Model of Opinion Polarization in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a model of opinion dynamics in social networks. Within the framework of the model, two interconnected processes--the excitation of network agents and the formation of their opinions--are studied. We demonstrate that, under certain conditions, this model preserves the differences in the agents' opinions and even leads to their polarization.

articleTitle: On an Approach to Measure the Level of Polarization of Individuals’ Opinions
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new metric to evaluate the level of polarization of individuals' opinions. Our approach is suitable in the case where opinions are evaluated by scalar values representing personal attitudes towards a fixed issue. We demonstrate how the metric works, applying it to a time series of VKontakte users' opinions that are devoted to a political topic. We report an increase in the level of polarization.

articleTitle: Symmetric Convex Mechanism of Opinion Formation Predicts Directions of Users’ Opinions Trajectories
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The symmetric convex mechanism of opinion formation requires an individual's opinion at the next time moment to be an average of their current opinion and opinions of their acquaintances. In this paper, we evaluate to what extent this dependency can describe the real data. Combining machine learning and social network analysis approaches, we retrieve a time series of VKontakte users' opinions as well as information about the friendship network connecting them. Our main result is that if absolute values of users' opinion transformations are huge enough, then its directions can be predicted by the proposed mechanism with sufficiently high accuracy. Namely, we report that if magnitudes are greater than 0.3, then accuracy is over 0.7. In turn, for changes whose absolute values exceed 0.6, accuracy is near one. Moreover, the dependency itself is monotonically increasing.

Author Keywords: symmetric convex mechanism of opinion formation

articleTitle: Management of Financial Flows on Transport
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This work is devoted to the analysis of cash flows arising from the operation of the vehicle. To assess the current value of cash flows, financial analysis methods are used. Having analyzed all these flows, we find the sum (algebraic) of all their modern values. The resulting value is the current value of the profit received from this vehicle for the entire period of its operation. The meaning of all these calculations is as follows: if the above profit is positive, then this vehicle will pay for itself, therefore, it makes sense to buy it; otherwise it's not worth buying. Such calculations are completely appropriate and widely used in financial analysis, but so far they are rarely used in transport science.

articleTitle: Structure of Hyperloop Systems with Intermediate Station
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we give a brief analysis of the work in the field of Hyperloop technology carried out in 2017-19. We show that this area is thriving. Further, we consider the structure of the Hyperloop passenger transportation system when an intermediate station appears between the start and end stations of the system. We assume that the time between departures of adjacent capsules from the start and end stations is short. We can compare it to the time of the capsule decelerates to stop at the new station. We consider the case when one part of the capsules should stop at the intermediate station, and the other part will follow to the final station without stopping. The proposed scheme is easily transformed into a bunch of structures with several intermediate stations.

Author Keywords: the structure of Hyperloop transportation systems Introduction

articleTitle: Destruction of the Resident Enterprise in the Special Economic Zone with Sanctions
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The activity of a special economic zone is defined by a dynamic equation, taking into account the individual strategies of residents. At a given point in time, in respect to the resident enterprise of a special economic zone, a regime is introduced that limits the flow of resources by 80% (sanctions), forming an integral indicator for a comprehensive assessment of the impact of sanctions on the enterprise. On the basis of the dynamic equation, an estimate of the economic damage for the potential SEZ of the Krasnoyarsk Territory is given.

articleTitle: Effective Management of Regional Projects Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: New methods of regional projects management are offered. The problem of existence of the admissible schedule for a complex of jobs with unstable parameters of their performance depending on the available resources and deadlines is investigated. The decision is based on reducing initial problem to the problem of minimum cost flow in a network. The fields of use of the received results in regional and municipal systems are offered.

articleTitle: Problems of Synthesis of Urban Highways Intersections and Methods for Their Solution
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Two interrelated aspects of the synthesis problem for regulated intersections of urban highways are considered. First, the question of determination of all possible distributions of the allowed intersection crossing trajectories between phases of the traffic light cycle (in other words, traffic separation schemes) is being resolved. An algorithm for solving this problem is described and illustrated. As a result, all feasible traffic separation schemes are being found, with a limit on the number of conflict points of merging tracks if needed. Secondly, the question of choosing the duration of phases for a specific traffic separation scheme is considered depending on the intensity of the incoming flows and their distributions among the permitted directions of intersection crossing. Methods are proposed for taking into account the transport demand and security requirements and a compromise between them.

articleTitle: Latent Factors of Protest Participation: A Basic Computational Model
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an agent-based model of protest participation. We take into account latent factors, such as individual anger with the system and group belief in the protest's success, as well as the risk of repression. We run a number of experimental simulations and look at distributions of protester numbers under various initial conditions.

articleTitle: Creation of Predictive Analytics System for Power Energy Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Paper presents a review of diagnostic methods and forecasting the technical condition. The relevance of the task of forecasting the values of technological parameters in the framework of solving the problem of forecasting the technical condition of power equipment for the condition-based repairs organization is shown. The architecture of the predictive analytics system for energy facilities has been developed. Methods of pre-processing Big data and forecasting parameter values are considered. The effectiveness of artificial neural networks in solving these problems is shown.

articleTitle: To the Question of Optimizing Product Life Cycle STAGES
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In given article the way of management of a life cycle of a product of aviation technics by optimization of stages of internal designing of aircrafts and minimization of risks of acceptance of key technical decisions at early stages of realisation of the project is considered. As an example of such optimization, the process of designing the nose part of a supersonic aircraft was chosen. On this example possibilities of essential reduction of terms and risks at the expense of working out and introduction of a complex technique of designing on complex criterion of the top level are visually shown. Introduction of the approach to the design of aircraft equipment described in the current work, in all directions of aircraft development will reduce the design cycles of fundamentally new products, significantly improve the accuracy of forecasting test results, and consequently minimize the risks of failure of the timing of government tests.

articleTitle: Principles of Physical and Information Model Integration for Cybersecurity Provision to a Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: For complex technical objects the research of cybersecurity problems should take into account both physical and information properties of the object. The paper considers a hybrid model that unifies information and physical models and may be used as a tool for countering cyber threats and for cybersecurity risk assessment at the design and operational stage of an object's lifecycle.

articleTitle: Stabilizing Regulator for Nonlinear Discrete Weakly Coupled Systems Based on the Pade Approximation
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of a stabilizing controller construction for nonlinear weakly coupled discrete systems of large dimension on the basis of an approximate solution of the state-dependent Riccati equation is investigated. The system is considered as a regularly perturbed system with a parameter in the right-hand side which allows to construct an asymptotic expansion of the solution of the Riccati equation in the powers of a small parameter. In some cases the obtained approximate solution can be improved by constructing a Pade approximation.

articleTitle: Control in a Group of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Based on Multi-Valued Logic
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A new method for constructing fuzzy knowledge bases for controlling a group of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is presented, in which a multi-valued logic is used instead of fuzzy one. The truth-values scale is not a chain and it generalizes the valuation notion of fuzzy logic.

articleTitle: The Optimality Principle "Mathematical Expectation-Var" and its Application in the Russian Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: An approach to the selection of optimality criteria in stochastic investment problems modeled as games with nature with known probabilities of states is proposed. This approach is based on the combination of efficiency criteria (expected payoff) and risk criteria (such as VAR). For the emerging two-criterion problem, the method of a transfer of one criterion into a constraint is used as a method of formalization. The case of pure strategies (the choice of one investment option) and the case of mixed strategies (diversification of investments) are considered.

articleTitle: Transformation of Power System Planning Methods and Models Considering Active Development of Thermal Low-carbon Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Suggestions for the transformation of methods and optimization models for power system planning are presented, which allow investigating the effective development scale of thermal low-carbon technologies. The results obtained by using these methods are shown, indicating the presence of significant areas for effective application of such technologies in Russia, including distributed generation plants.

articleTitle: Modeling of Short-Term Exchange Rates Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The new model of short-term exchange rate dynamics is constructed and the final factors dependence of the exchange rate is derived, based on the further development of the author`s concept of International Flows Equilibrium Exchange Rate modeling. The influence of crisis phenomena in the domestic Russian currency market on the model in the short term is investigated and quantified.

articleTitle: Application of Crash-Tests for Graph Analytics of Electronic Payment Complex System for Investigation of System Economic Security
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper suggests a mathematical model of the electronic money payments' system, based on the graph analytics methods. This approach allows carrying out the system stability analysis on the base of crash-tests developed by authors. These crash-tests simulate the consecutive destruction of some central and peripheral nodes of graph (participants of electronic money payment system) due to both faults and failures of hardware and equipment and hacker attacks. The integral estimation of system stability is developed as a linear combination of graph few centrality measures ranked in a special order. The paper considers dynamics of graph centrality metrics and total metric during graph destruction and determines the critical level of destruction using a matrix for economic security.

articleTitle: Transport Hubs as the Basis of Multimodal Passenger Transportation
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article focuses on the theory of creating transport interchanges as principal elements of transport infrastructure, thus allowing people to use all the advantages of different means of transport, providing high-quality and easily accessible service, using the experience of development and organization tendencies of transport hubs in Russia and abroad.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Information Systems based on Conceptual Models
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Information systems using conceptual models of the subject domain are considered. The conceptual model consists of the conceptual structure and description of the content of the concepts included in it. The conceptual structure is defined as a set of concepts on which generalization and association map are given. It is shown that due to the semantic invariance of the formalism used, the characteristics of information systems, in particular, their scalability, are improved.

articleTitle: Coordinated Management in Hierarchical Network Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of forming hierarchical relations between agents in a network structure by mechanisms of coordinated planning and fines. It investigates the conditions of some agent leadership in the network structure and the emergence of an additional level of hierarchy as a result.

articleTitle: Models of Forming and Processing Packages of Transport Services
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The factors that determine the behavior of the subjects of the transport process, the interaction of shippers, logistics companies, and carriers during the formation and execution of transport services are considered. Mathematical definitions and statements of problems are given, based on which an algorithm is developed for modeling the formation and planning of the execution of packages of orders for transport services. The problem of determining the minimum number of vehicles and their optimal redistribution to fulfill a given package of orders is being put and solved.

articleTitle: Digital Platforms Clustering Model
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: the paper discusses, from system positions, the problems of the digital economy and digital platforms in Russia, provides a critical analysis of the DP definitions used in the country and gives the original definition of a digital platform. We suggest a mechanism for creating DPs based on a mathematical model of digital platform clustering. Based on this model, we propose a scientifically sound approach to calculate the need for the experts required for the digital economy.

articleTitle: On Approaches to Identifying Information Spread Channels in Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, a novel approach to identifying information spread channels in online social networks is proposed. The approach uses the actional model of influence to determine the most significant channels.

articleTitle: Structural Analysis of Processes of Sustainable Development of Systems of Social Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The axiomatic and constructive apparatus of the processes of sustainable controlled development of social environment systems are being formed. Sustainability is associated with the resolution of conflicts by a sustainable compromise.

articleTitle: Computational Method Basing on Deep Neural Networks to Detect and Classify Defects, Appearing in Rivet Assemblies of Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A causal analysis of the occurrence of defects in holes and sockets, mortgages and closing heads of rivets when producing rivet joints of aircraft equipment was conducted. The statement of the problem of defects detection and classification is given. The computational method of defects detection and classification in rivet joints of aircraft equipment by using deep neural networks is developed. The example of modeling is given.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of the Estimated Signals in the State and Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Standard synthesis of discontinuous corrective actions is considered for the observer of states and disturbances, which implies the occurrence of ideal sliding modes in the virtual space of observation errors. In practice, a real sliding mode occurs in the boundary layer of the switching surface, which reduces the quality of estimation. Methods for improving the accuracy of the estimated signals by varying the amplitudes of discontinuous corrective actions are proposed.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Models in a Crisis Management Programme
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes a model for resource distribution in the organization crisis program, taking into account the priority of projects for obtaining the most significant cumulative effect.

articleTitle: Tracking Emotional State of a Person with Artificial Intelligence Methods and Its Application to Customer Services
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of recognizing the emotional state of a person using neural networks. Some popular methodological aspects and methods of recognition of facial expressions known to date are described in detail. An author's algorithm proposed, which seems to have certain advantages in comparison with the existing approaches.

Author Keywords: methods for identifying key points of the face

articleTitle: Designing Supervisory Control Systems for NPP: New Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the new capabilities of modern technologies for the design of modern systems for automated control systems of nuclear power plants.

articleTitle: Collision Avoidance for Continuum Robot Using FABRIK Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Continuum robots are manipulators able to bend at any point along their structure. This feature allows continuum robots to work in areas with complex geometry. In this regard, they are used as instruments and endoscopes in industry and medicine. Inverse kinematics for continuum robots is using for control and path planning. Recently, Forward And Backward Reaching Inverse Kinematics (FABRIK) algorithm has been used for solving inverse kinematics issue for continuum robots. For this, arcs of continuum robot are simplified to virtual links. But virtual links can not be used to define the distance between continuum robot body and obstacle without restoring whole robot section. In this paper, we propose a method for obstacle avoidance for multi-section continuum robot using FABRIK algorithm. The simulation results for the planar case show that the proposed method is able to avoid unwanted collisions.

articleTitle: Simplified Modeling of Continuous Glycaemia Curve. Simple Model of Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of reducing the number of parameters in a model describing glucose metabolism in both a healthy person and a patient with Type 1 diabetes is considered. We propose a method for selection of parameters significant for the identification of a personalized model. Comparison of the glycaemia curves calculated under different parameters values illustrates the method efficiency.

articleTitle: Towards the Foundations of the Structural Identification Methodology of Large-Scale Technical Objects for Designing Automatic Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this article, we substantiate the high relevance and practical importance of research in the field of creating a methodology of structural identification for the design of automatic control systems with the required properties. In particular, we give a brief description of the current state of scientific knowledge about structural identification. Secondly, we formulate the problem statement of the methodology of structural identification. We reveal the basic content of the key concepts of this methodology. In particular, we develop the reference model of the subject's behavior of the rational structural identification.

articleTitle: The Use of Deep Neural Networks to Recognize Network Traffic Abnormalities in Enterprise Information and Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: It is proposed to recognize the network traffic abnormalities by using different deep neural network architectures. The experiment in detecting DoS attacks was conducted. The influences of neural networks layers combinations on the accuracy characteristics are revealed. New is the strengthening of the classification, through the reinforcement of an input vector to its cluster evaluation.

articleTitle: Investigation of Lyapunov Modal Analysis Framework Using the Two-Area Test Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper investigates the possible advantages of the recently proposed framework of Lyapunov modal analysis compared to the conventional modal analysis. In particular, using a two-area Kundur test power system, we investigate two novel indicators: Lyapunov participation factors (PFs) and Lyapunov modal interaction energy (LMIE). Lyapunov PFs characterize the relative participation of the system modes in the perturbation energy accumulated in the state variables over time. We have observed that in contrast to conventional PFs, the Lyapunov PFs show an increase in the participation of those modes that approach the boundary of their stability. Therefore, this indicator combines information on the relationship of eigenmodes with state variables and on the stability of these modes. In contrast to conventional modal analysis, the averaged LMIE allows to characterize the interaction between two modes in a system in terms of total perturbation energy produced by their mutual actions over time. The experiment showed that the LMIE values allow one to detect and characterize the processes of merging and separation of eigenmodes in the system.

articleTitle: Differential Invariants of Third Order Evolutionary Non-Linear PDEs
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: For the third order evolution differential equations, the algebra of differential invariants with respect to the pseudogroup of point transformations is constructed. Such equations arise in the study of filtration processes (the Rapoport - Leas equation), the theory of nonlinear waves (the Korteweg - de Vries equation).

articleTitle: Using the Risk Potential Assessment of Energy Objects in the SMS System
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses the crucial functions of the "Safety management system" in terms of opportune identification of hazards and vulnerabilities. The introduction of such systems in the energy sector will increase the security of the functioning of energy facilities.

articleTitle: Operational Searching for Separated Parts of Carrier Rockets by Means of Unmanned Air Vehicle Group1
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach to tacking problems of preflight and operational planning of UAV group actions. The principal difference of such problems from vogageur's already known problem is the registration of a service time table. Developed instrument of planning automation allows increasing efficiency of searching for separated parts of carrier-rockets by means of an UAV groups.

Author Keywords: separated part of a carrier rocket

articleTitle: Modelling of the Russian Federation Gas Industry Innovative Development under Conditions Risks Strengthening
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to improving the modelling of innovative development of the gas industry of the Russian Federation in the face of increased risks - technological, sanctioning, market, regulatory. There is a high degree of uncertainty in export expectations in the form of uncertainties in export price levels and export volumes, transit volumes, and technology development risks.

articleTitle: Exploring the Taxonomy of USB-Based Attacks
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A variety of USB-based attacks is being increased rapidly. Researchers manage to identify more and more threats and vulnerabilities, often with proof-of-concept practical demonstrations. USB-based vulnerabilities' databases are being updated constantly. There are plenty of publications, including threat models and corresponding analysis, but attacks taxonomy is rarely being a goal of investigation. Furthermore, the great majority of such investigations and papers refers to cyberattacks in whole, in such cases USB-based attacks remain to be unreviewed. In this paper we aim to review current state of the USB-based attacks taxonomy studies. An attempt to summarize all well-known investigations and the additional material to create an enhanced taxonomy is represented.

articleTitle: Criteria for Planning by Large-Scale Innovation Projects
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the problem of minimizing the duration of the project and maximizing its reliability index in the conditions of the Rayleigh model of the project activity reliability index, which defined by the digraph with disjunctive input arcs. The solution of the proposed problems of planning large-scale innovative projects according to the criteria of discrete minimax and discrete maximin, presented in the form of nonlinear programming problems, is found with the help of an effective quasi-Newton method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Capacity Expansion Problem in Competitive Markets
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper examines the problem of choice investment strategies of firms in an oligopoly market. We study the impact of investment strategies of companies on their financial performance and the efficiency of investment under demand uncertainty. A mathematical model for choosing investments in the development of production capacities of companies in competitive oligopolistic markets based on the Nash equilibrium presented, formulated as an optimization problem. Two types of market are considered: a market with elastic demand (Cournot market) and a market with inelastic demand. In the first case, the problem is formulated as a set of interrelated problems of quadratic optimization. To solve this problem, a method of converting the original problem to solving the mixed complementarity problem (MCP) is proposed. In the second case, a method for solving the problem is proposed, based on the joint use of multi-agent modeling and analysis of matrix games. A simulation model was developed that takes into account the relationship between the investments of companies (agents) and market dynamics. A solution of the problem reduced to the analysis of the dynamic bimatrix game, wherein the payoff matrix formed by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: On Job Flows for Control System Information Base Updating and Situational Factors Affecting Them
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Over the years, the maintenance of information necessary for control systems - information bases - has been a thorny issue being raised by both researchers' and practitioners' communities. These days, information bases of modern industrial computerized control systems are forced to be modified too often, so the process of maintenance is highly iterative and should be more accurately referred to as updating. The matter is an exceptionally high rate of arriving jobs that create real flows. In this situation, characteristics of job flows are becoming extremely important for designing and applying suitable updating tools and estimating timing budgets for updating. However, no appropriate law or model for job flow prediction is presently available. The article advises to take into account particular situations, or situational factors, to explain and forecast job flows. To advocate this idea, a brief review of situational factors affecting information systems is presented, and the most critical ones for information base updating are selected. As an example of putting the idea into practice, the results of the investigation of nuclear power plant upper-level control system information bases are presented, and the influence of situational factors is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Managing Methods of Investment Projects in the Field of Education on the Example of France
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this study, we assessed the impact of investments in various areas of education such as pre-school education, elementary school, secondary education, higher education, and higher specialized education on the socio-economic indicators of France and formulated recommendations for management financial flows.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Technical Objects under Mixed Parametric Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The methodology of the optimal design of technical objects under parametric mixed uncertainty has been developed. The article proposes the model of optimal design within the framework of the chance theory for modeling systems with mixed uncertainty. As an example, we formalize and solve the problem of calculating the weight parameters of a passenger aircraft at the preliminary design stage under parametric mixed uncertainty.

Author Keywords: the task of aircraft weight parameters optimization

articleTitle: Method of Funding Investment Programs in Network Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers investing funds problems for the implementation of interrelated projects and jobs of a complex project or scientific-technical program in the case of insufficient funding. It is necessary to exclude the part of the projects from the program in this case. The paper proposes algorithms for selecting the optimal set of priority projects in funding at network structures.

articleTitle: New Silk Way: Effective Management of Container Transportations in the Conditions of Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The current state and problems of formation of container trains along a route and the transport and logistic centers for "A new silk way" is considered. The principles of formation of trains on railway transport of the countries forming freight traffics are offered. The perspective models and methods allowing to carry out the continuous stream of container transportations in the international message in the conditions of uncertainties for increase in management efficiency are offered.

articleTitle: Modeling Price Effects of Upgrading Strategies of Thermal Power Plants on the basis of Low Carbon Technologies in a Competitive Market
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A methodical approach to estimation of the price effects resulted from the renewal of thermal power plants based on energy-efficient and low-carbon technologies is proposed. The problems and results of modeling long-term effects in the spot electricity market under the influence of new technologies on the supply curve profile and the value of marginal cost (competitive price) of electricity are considered.

articleTitle: Oil Recovery Optimization for Shale Deposits
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The economic optimization model for shale oil (gas) recovery is proposed. The relationship between the optimal initial well flow rate and the oil recovery factor was established. The dependence of optimal values on oil price, the geological site resources, and capital investments were traced. A numerical example was provided.

articleTitle: Interface Software Channels of Large-scale systems in APCS of NPP
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Methods to program interface software channels including in software of gateways between the Top-level subsystem and Low-level subsystems of Automated Process control system (APCS) of Nuclear power plant (NPP) are considering. The structure of data packets in gateways, manners of data exchange, and algorithms to implement such manners are describing.

articleTitle: Assessing Algorithm of the Risk Potential of Critical Infrastructure of a NPP Based on Technical and Economic Indicators
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: For significant objects of critical information infrastructure, including nuclear facilities, methods for findings anomalies, malfunctions, and diagnostics, as well as operator information support systems (OISS), are playing an increasingly important role in order to increase safety and reliability of operation. One of the tasks to be solved within the framework of the OISS is the task of calculating technical and economic indicators (TEI) and its relation with ensuring the normal operation of NPPs. TEIs characterize the effectiveness, reliability, and longevity of power equipment during its operation. The conditions for optimal operation of nuclear power plants determined in the process of analyzing TEIs. Therefore, the analysis of indicators is one of the essential tasks of the automated process control system of nuclear power plants. The informational task of TEIs in real-time based on data mining and forecast models of the risk potential of the critical infrastructure of the facility will allow operational personnel to take measures in advance to prevent the technological process from exceeding permissible operating limits.

articleTitle: About the Possibilities of the Operational Gaming Simulation of the Processes of Logistic Interactions
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The principles of representation of processes of logistic interaction in the form of operational game processes are considered. The concept of decision support of logistic nature with the use of operational game scenario modeling is formulated. The possibility of developing a universal platform for generating IAS decision support in logistics coalitions of diverse nature is discussed.

articleTitle: Log-Periodic Power Law Autonomous Stock Market Model
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: For the empirically well explored LPPLS phenomenon (log-periodic power law with singularity) is known and used as a market crash precursor, we propose an autonomous dynamical theoretical model. First, we explain a non-oscillative trend with singularity. For that, we consider a long-term excessive investment demand we've derived from constant leverage investor model. Due to the trend deviation suppression (and due to the noise agents activity that balance trend followers buy or sell actions), we formally write supply side of the market balance equation that in our view is proportional to the trend deviation calculated as a second-order tailor term based on the non-oscillative return rate derivative normalized on gauss volatility deviation. We derive from the parameters of the best constant leverage strategy this conglomerate looks like a logarithmic derivative of the smoothed return rate. Due to the supply-demand balance we come to a sequence of two-four differential equations, first leads to hyperbolic time dependence for the return rate, the next leads to a reciprocal power-law for the price. Then we come to a log-periodic oscillations in a second-order equation.

articleTitle: Algorithms of Structural Modeling of Pipeline Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the solution of problems of structural modeling of pipeline systems that arose in the process of creating an automated information system using methods of graph theory. It describes efficient data storage methods and the basic algorithm for finding all paths between two vertices.

Author Keywords: algorithm for finding paths in graphs
implementation of graph data storage structure

articleTitle: Functional Safety of Software Systems Important for NPP Safety
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Designing systems important for NPP safety is basing on fulfilling the demands of normative documents and ensuring the quality of soft- and hardware systems throughout the entire life cycle. The most critical tasks in ensuring the quality of soft- and hardware complex are the phase for the formation of demands for a designed or modifiable system and their consequent verification. An increase in demands for the quality of software (SW) for systems important for NPP safety at all phases of the life-cycle is associated with an increase in the complicity and functionality of the software and has led to the need to develop methods to justify the safety of the systems themselves and the software included in them. The paper discusses a method based on the construction of "safety functions," the implementation of which subsequently verified. This method is using in SW verification for upper-level systems of APCS and can be used to analyze cybersecurity, information, and fault tolerance of soft- and hardware systems.

articleTitle: Concept of Neural Swarm Mapping
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This article explores the problem of implementing the principles of swarm intelligence in the process of preparing thematic self-organizing maps for geospatial development studies in the environment of geographic information science.

articleTitle: Implementation of Wavelet Analysis in the Diagnosis of Integrated Systems and Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The original methodological approach to the recognition of the anomalous state of electronic modules of software and hardware communication systems of large integrated systems based on wavelet transformation is proposed. The algorithm of forming the base of anomalous states of integrated systems and communication complexes is developed. The simulation of thermal processes of software and hardware communication systems using computer aided design (CAD) systems.

articleTitle: Influence of Deactivated Agents in Social Networks: Switching Between French-De Groot Models and Friedkin-Johnsen Model
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper shows the influence of deactivated agents in social networks: switching between French-De Groot models and Friedkin-Johnsen model.

articleTitle: Localization of the Spectra of Laplacian Matrices in the Region Bounded by an Ellipse
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper we study the problem of localization of the spectra of Laplacian matrices. An expression was obtained for the solution of the Krein equation. This expression generalizes the previously result obtained for the Lyapunov equation with a simple matrix. A condition of belonging of the spectrum of Laplacian matrices to region bounded by an ellipse is also obtained.

articleTitle: Assessment of Spatiotemporal Air Pollution Trend Using Geo-Oriented Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The report analyzes the existing methods of data collection and promising trends in the creation of air pollution geo-information maps. A method for detection of the point contamination source coordination using the developed mobile application based on a geo-oriented social network and unmanned aerial vehicles is proposed.

Author Keywords: detection of the contamination source coordinate

articleTitle: Algorithm for Assessing and Managing key Financial Performance Indicators of a Sports Club
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In the paper is proposed an algorithm and functional model for identifying key indicators of the financial performance of sports clubs. The obtained indicators are representative and recommended to managers for monitoring and management. Relevant automation recommendations have been developed that will help managers make decisions and minimize the costs of managerial errors.

Author Keywords: automation of the assessment and monitoring of performance indicators.

articleTitle: Application of the Hurst Exponent for the Stock Prices Forecasting in Investment Systems Management
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In the carried out research is confirmed that the application of the Hurst exponent in forecasting the time series of stock prices and stability of trend can improve forecasting results, but it is possible only in the short-term time period. The Hurst exponent can be used as an additional indicator (data risk in forecasting) and can improve forecast data reliability in the large-scale investment systems.

articleTitle: Simulation of Thermal Fields in an Anisotropic Alternating Saturated Porous Medium for Environmental Monitoring Tasks Using UAV
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This article considers computer simulation of the thermal fields in an anisotropic alternating-saturated porous medium. Such simulation allows to predict the impact on the medium environment at the design stage of the technogenic object (e.g. for a heat transport system) or detect hidden thermal fields sources with an adverse impact on the soil.

articleTitle: Problems of the Development in Macro- and Microeconomic Systems Harmonization Based on the Labour Marketcontrol
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In order to intensify the transition of the state economic complex to the information technology mode, this article considers an approach to the formation of a strategy for harmonizing the development of macroeconomic and microeconomic sectors. The functional model of economic system agents presents competitive knowledge carriers to the labor market mechanisms of human resources formation use the education logistics as a tool for managing the development of production and industrial relations. A pilot experiment on the nature-like educational technologies shows the provision of the GEF and the requirements of the employer.

Author Keywords: strategy of harmonization in macroeconomic and microeconomic sectors development

articleTitle: Multiexpert Planning System for Repair Programs of Power-Generating Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the problem of repair program planning at big power-generating enterprises; the multiexpert system for decision making support is proposed. Two basic approaches for knowledge gaining are considered, the classification model is developed. Different approaches to the interaction of knowledge base and historical data are proposed. Algorithm for interaction between the base of production rules and predictive analysis system is developed, experiment with classical classification problem is performed.

articleTitle: Control Algorithms for Large-Scale Railway Network Logistics
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problems that are being talked about here are related to the scientific field of supply chain management. This article focuses on the preferred control algorithm selection for large-scale railway network logistics for the special case. In this particular case, the dispatch and destination stations belong to the various regional rails. The statistical approach is applied here to the choice of the preferred control algorithm for rail cargo logistics. The peculiarity of our approach is the application of standard score z-test modifications for timing characteristics comparison. The results obtained can be used for logistics process optimization and improvement. These findings may be applicable to large-scale railway networks and transportation networks that combine the different modes of transport.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Forecasting Stock Prices of Russian Banks
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper explores the use of some well-known time series forecasting methods for predicting the value of stocks of Russian banks. The authors proposed a regression model of stock value. Some known data for banks of the Russian banking system was taken. The authors use it to investigate the effectiveness of the studied methods.

articleTitle: The Multicriteria Choice Problem of the Loan and Deposit Policy of the Coalition of Borrowers
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A coalition of borrowers is being considered, which in its organizational structure looks like a traditional bank. We formulate a discrete-time model and the corresponding control problem boils down to solving a bilevel optimization problem. The choice of optimal deposit and loan rates is proposed using the parameter space investigation method. The result of a computational experiment is given.

articleTitle: On Multivalued Solutions of Equations of One-Dimensional Gas Flow
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to global solvability of Cauchy problem for one class of equations of one-dimensional gas flow. Existence and uniqueness of maximal multivalued solutions of Cauchy problem is established. In case of an ordinary differential equation a key property of its solutions with maximal intervals of existence is to tend to the boundary of its domain. A direct analog of this property for the maximal multivalued solutions of the equations of the class under consideration is proved.

articleTitle: The Health Assessment and Prediction Algorithms Development for Electromechanical Flight Control Actuator Using Data Mining Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper proposes a general data analysis scheme for the electromechanical flight control actuator (EMA) technical state determination with health assessment and predictive algorithms using data mining methods. To assess the technical state of the EMA and form a base of precedents, which is the initial information of the data mining methods, the EMA mathematical model to be used is considered. The studies are relevant to work on the creation of an electric aircraft, which uses the technology of EMA.

articleTitle: Control Models at the Public-Private Partnership (PPP)
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In current conditions of widespread use of information and communication technologies (digital economy), research on decision-making problems based on processing large amounts of data, attracting various algorithms and models, is becoming increasingly important. The full sphere of the economy is represented by investment projects, which, as a rule, have a large geographical scale, a large number of active participants, internal dynamics and a variety of forms of interaction of players. Here, the public-private partnership in the economy is used as an object for the application of theoretical constructions.

articleTitle: Using Reinforced Learning Methods to Control Cube Robots
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Unconventional robot chassis remain an under-explored venue of research that poses numerous hard problems in engineering, control and locomotion. In particular, cube-shaped robots have appeared in various architectural concepts and sketches, as well as robotics labs and proposals on robot swarms. Their advantages are inherent stability in the absence of power input, lack of external moving parts, which makes them useful in liquid or hazardous environment, and natural affinity towards stacking and forming semi-permanent structures. In this article we explore the possibility of applying reinforced learning techniques to the problem of controlling a cube-shaped robot. Several existing algorithms are tried on a simpler cart-pole system. Finally, we elaborate on an idea of abandoning a black-box approach and using automated differentiation to implement a numerical rigid-body simulator that can provide gradients for optimization.

articleTitle: Automation of Autonomous Largescale Production Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper covers the procedure how to choose the most suitable (based on the number of workers in the sustainability system) automation scheme in autonomous production systems. An abstract of model of production is used, such model being invariant with the types of technological operations. Three levels of automation at an autonomous station are in focus: Fully manual assembly of products with no automata. Product automated production by means of purchased automata. Automated production of both products and automata used for the product manufacture. This paper also highlights the algorithms of determining the optimal sorting of the types of robots by the varieties of technological operations.

Author Keywords: production theory invariant with the types of technological operations

articleTitle: The Method of Assessing the Level of Compliance of Divisions of the Complex Network for the Corporate Information Security Policy Indicators
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The method of assessment of degree of compliance of divisions of the complex distributed corporate information system to a number of information security indicators is offered. As a result of the methodology implementation a comparative assessment of compliance level of each of the divisions for the corporate information security policy requirements may be given. This assessment may be used for the purpose of further decision-making by the management of the corporation on measures to minimize risks as a result of possible implementation of threats to information security.

Author Keywords: ranking of the values of indicators

articleTitle: Decomposition of a Media Event Through the Definition of Information Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: An unexpected event affects the media space of social networks and through the impacts on social processes in society. These phenomena need to be recorded, investigated, and interpreted. However, existing approaches to the collection and analysis of textual data place social outcomes beyond the research framework. This article proposes an integrated approach to the consideration of media space as a set of media events. To understand the nature of a media event, it is necessary to decompose it to the level of information waves. These concepts (media event and information waves) allow us to build a meaningful methodology and draw conclusions about the nature of the publication flows following the event. The explosion in Magnitogorsk, which occurred on December 31, 2018, and had a comprehensive public response, was analyzed as an example of a media event. The article shows the possibility of combining sociological methodology as a meaningful analytical framework and mathematical and linguistic procedures to identify text clusters.

articleTitle: Statistical Modeling in Agricultural Insurance
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of actuarial calculations in agricultural insurance and the use for this purpose of the only information available in the form of a sufficiently long time series. Model description of the main criteria for the evaluation of insurance programs that require specific calculations using the available information is given. Algorithms of such calculations are given. It is concluded that for such calculations, it is advisable to use statistical modeling methods, often using as random measurements directly series of statistical data on crop yields. The article considers issues of efficiency of the functioning of insurance companies in the insurance programs of the crop. Much attention is paid to the issue of its financial stability. The issues of providing the calculations with the necessary information are discussed.

articleTitle: The Simulation Models in Grid Methods of Uniform Probing
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article provides an overview of modern problems of improving large-scale systems solved by means of using grid methods of uniform probing. It establishes a connection between approximate optimization algorithms for poorly formalized systems with the method of finite difference of mathematical physics. The finite difference method is known since the time of Euler, but began to develop rapidly only with the advent of high-speed computing. This method has also name of the grid method, widely used for solving partial differential equations. Suggested algorithms on the base of grid methods of uniform probing extend the capabilities of grid methods for the study of systems, which have in their description a set of non-differentiable functions. The appointment of the stages of grid methods of uniform probing with the use of simulation models to describe the investigated or projected systems is analyzed. A set of examples of approximate optimization of dynamic stochastic systems described by means of simulation statistical models demonstrate the features of the considered approaches. Models were checked for adequacy, and program implementations were created on the basis of high-speed procedures.

articleTitle: Development of Electronic Flight Bag Software Based on Expert System for Computing of Optimal Aircraft Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Foundations of rule based expert systems are applied in development of an electronic flight bag software application for aircraft takeoff and landing performance calculations. The architecture of the expert system software is developed. Development of the system is carried out for aircraft Tu-204.

articleTitle: Convergent Principles of Holistic Assembly of Strategic Subjects Using the Situation Centers of Development and Cognitive Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper addresses the issue of the holistic assembly of strategic subjects that cannot be carried out by classical approaches with logical and formalized techniques only. To take into consideration non-formalizable aspects of collective decision-making (unconscious, corporate spirit, emotions, feelings, thoughts, meditations, etc.), the principles of ensuring the convergence of the holistic assembly are formulated based on the methods of inverse problem-solving, artificial intelligence, category and topology theories, thermodynamics, and quantum semantics. This paper focuses on the application of quantum semantics that helps to accelerate the convergence of the holistic assembly of strategic subjects, making it more purposeful and sustainable. Some practical applications are listed.

articleTitle: Multilevel Data Acquisition System of Energy Losses in Recreation Areas
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of assessing energy in recreational areas is considered. Increasing energy consumption in cooling and heating systems of buildings and structures in recreational areas leads to various types of heat energy loss. A problem of data acquisition of energy losses in recreational areas is discussed. Multilevel data acquisition system that uses data from remote sensing of the earth, aerial photography and surveying from drones, as well as data from the internal monitoring of the thermal state of objects in the recreation zone is proposed. As additional data, statistical data on the energy consumption of objects of the recreation zone are used. The application of big data paradigm, i.e. the possibility of determining the level of energy loss using a database that stores arrays of thermograms images of different level of detailing is considered. The problem of filtering thermal images using convolutional neural networks is considered.

articleTitle: Large Scale Solar and Wind Power: Systemic Impact
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Large scale introduction of solar and wind parks into power grids results in negative consequences. That is mainly due to the stochastic nature of the power generated by the parks. Now, we have assessed the negative impacts of the solar and wind park introduction into the power grid of the South of Russia.

articleTitle: Evaluating Recovery Facilities Placement Options in Railway Network Nodes
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the possibility of applying a weighted placement of graph theory to the choice of locations for recovery trains, identifies natural and cost indicators which influence the choice of solution, and proposes a method for solving the problem of selecting locations for recovery trains.

articleTitle: Generation of Trends in Spatial Inhomogeness of Region Based on the Analysis Information Flows of the Internet-Space
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The methods of processing large unstructured data flows from the perspective of identifying regional events are analyzed. An approach to generating hypotheses in the directions of spatial asymmetry and heterogeneity on the basis of information flows of the Internet space is proposed.

articleTitle: Modeling the Impact of Migration Crisis on Economic Growth and Social Inequality
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper deals with the construction and study of a model of economic growth that takes into account those migration flows that add to labor. The model is based on the Cobb-Douglas production function; one of the factors of this function is the aggregate labor. We distinguish between skilled and unskilled labor, as they contribute differently to the output, and between native and migrant labor as they have different dynamics. The migration flow in each labor class is assumed to be proportional to the difference between the average level of consumption in this category and an exogenously given function, which describes the level of consumption in the source countries of labor migrants. Special attention is given to migration crises. The study of the model is aimed at analyzing the impact of migration flows and migration crises on economic growth and inequality.

articleTitle: Phase Transitions in Euler Flows of Dieterici Gases
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we study 3-dimensional stationary flows of real gases described by Euler equations. As a model of a thermodynamic state, we take the Dieterici state equation. We investigate critical phenomena emerging along the flow of such gases. Namely, the solution of Euler equations in case of source is given and the domains in space where phase transition occurs are constructed.

articleTitle: Emotionally Dependent Oculographic and Brain-Computer Interfaces Based on Additional Channel of Human-Computer Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents a model for evaluating the emotional state based on the involuntarily controlled signals of the user of oculographic and neurocomputer interfaces. For such signals were selected the parameters of heart rate variability, whose recording is well-proven both at the firmware level and from the point of view of processing and interpretation of the results. As markers for evaluating the user's emotional state as a compromise between the interface rate, the accuracy of the obtained results and the resource intensity, were chosen the values of the mean-square deviation of the pulse indicators (RR intervals, peak-to-peak segments of the pulse waves) that can be associated with the spectral estimate of the total power of the heart rate variability spectrum. Based on the game theory, a model was proposed for selecting by the firmware part of the interface of one of the several competing algorithms for processing the signals coming from the user. The possible parameters for evaluating the "gain" of the firmware suite were considered. It was demonstrated that the option containing the indicator that reflects the value of the difference between the dispersion of the heart rate variability at rest and when working with interfaces, in the process of execution of the strategy, weighted for the time of realization of this strategy, is more preferable for formation of the channel controlling the selection of the algorithms of processing the patient signals by a firmware suite.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Anti-Tumor Vaccinotherapy: The Interaction of Immune System with Tumor Cells
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This work presents the mathematical model of antitumor virus vaccine therapy and the results of the search for effective schemes of its use on the base of the developed software system, which includes a number of mathematical models: (1) a mathematical model of antitumor vaccine therapy, which describes the mechanism of two-stage death of cancer cells because of the injection of the virus (2) a mathematical model of an infectious disease G.I. Marchuk, which describes the development of the body's immune response to the injection of the virus, (3) a mathematical model with discontinuous trajectories, which describes the dynamics of experimental tumor growth curves. The results were obtained by conducting computational experiments on a software package in the MatLab-Simulink system. As a result of the computational experiment, schemes for the injection of a virus vaccine were determined, by which it is possible to stabilize or regress tumor growth.

articleTitle: Selection of Parameters of the Mechanism of Distribution Without Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: All performers of the project have no competitors. Performers receive financial resources for the performance of works of the project. The use of a distribution mechanism based on the principle of equal profitability makes it possible to calculate the number of financial resources allocated to each contractor. For the distribution of funds, performers must report the values of the planned costs of the work. For the encourage performers to report projected costs that are minimally different from actual costs, it is necessary to establish the appropriate parameters of the distribution mechanism. If such parameters exist, then the distribution mechanism without manipulation.

articleTitle: Main Approaches to Neuro-Evolutionary Imitation Modeling of Macroeconomic Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The current state of methodological approaches to agent-based modeling of economic systems is considered. Critical observations concerning classical modeling methods are systematized, the main points are derived, the solution of which should be provided by a new methodology. This study may be useful to specialists in the field of machine learning, macroeconomic forecasting, and evolutionary methods.

articleTitle: The Use of Multi-Criterial Approach for the Evaluation of the Results and Effects of Investment Projects and Strategies in Power Sector
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents an approach to substantiation of strategic decisions in the field of power sector technological transformation. The approach discussed is based on multi-criterial evaluation of the effects of such transformation obtained with the help of optimization models used for the least-cost choice of the electricity generation mix and financial models used for assessment of financial stability of different technological segments of the power sector.

articleTitle: On the Influence of Noneconomic Factors on the Mortgage Housing Loan Markets in the EU and CEE Countries. Statistical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Regression analysis was used to estimate the share of non-economic influences on the level of development of mortgage housing loan markets in the EU and CEE countries in the overall impact of economic and non-economic factors.

articleTitle: Comparison of Flatness-Based and Model Predictive Control Approaches
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the navigation problem for simple vehicle amidst static and dynamic constraints. Reference trajectory is supposed to be obtained by the planner and we need to generate control that solves the path following problem. For this purpose, two approaches are used: the model predictive control and flatness-based method. Results of the conducted computational experiments show the best value of the performance with and without continuous random noise flatness-based regulator.

articleTitle: The Concept of Virtual Testing Ground for Regulations of Discharges to the Water Basin of the Enterprises-Users of Natural Resources
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The method is considered to scheduling wastewater discharges of water users, providing the maximum permissible concentration of pollutants in the water basin.

articleTitle: Complex Network Cybersecurity Monitoring Method
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers one of the methods of efficient allocation of limited resources in special-purpose devices (sensors) to monitor complex network unit cybersecurity.

articleTitle: The Development and Application Signal Graphs and Discrete-Continuous Laplace Transform Methods for the Heat Exchangers Characteristics Determining
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The comparison was made of two methods proposed by the authors for determining the characteristics of multipoint models of heat exchangers. It is shown that for radiation surfaces and convective surfaces with external boiling or condensing coolant, it is advisable to apply the signal graph method, and for direct-flow and counter-flow convective heat exchangers with single-phase agents, the discrete-continuous Laplace transform has an absolute advantage.

articleTitle: Methodical Approaches to Agricultural Risk Estimate in Forecasting the Economic Effect of Applying Data of the Earth’s Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses methodical approaches to agricultural risk estimate in forecasting the economic effect of applying data of the Earth's remote sensing in the transition to the digital economy. We consider the problems of these technologies' effectiveness in agriculture at present.

Author Keywords: data of the Earth’s remote sensing

articleTitle: Navigation in NSR as Large-Scale System: Ship Path Analysis in Non-Severe Ice Condition
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In this study we make ship path analysis depending by the ice compactness in non-severe condition using by heuristic A* algorithm. We introduce simulations performed within framework Netlogo. Finally, we introduce calculation results as research of stochastic properties of ship paths.
