articleTitle: Monitoring Power Quality in Conflict Situations
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The rationale for the need for continuous monitoring of such an indicator of power quality as the level of harmonic components is given. An approach to the design of harmonic network filters and a method of monitoring their level in the supplied electricity with the definition of the source of their occurrence and increase is proposed.

articleTitle: Method for Strategic Monitoring and Forecasting Potential in the Management of Large-Scale Regional Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach for strategic monitoring and forecasting potential. The information system built on proposed methodology will make it possible to smooth out the influence of non-urban areas on the unevenness of economic activity in spatial development.

articleTitle: Airborne Geophysical Technologies as a Basis for Diamond Field Prognoses in Regional and State Scale
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We show how to increase the effectiveness of the prognoses of kimberlite bodies by using airborne geophysical technologies. We show the advantages of electromagnetic and magnetic methods for predicting kimberlite pipes. You will see examples of a regional diamond survey in Angola and Siberia.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Efficiency of Managing the Population Reproduction
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Cybernetic approach to fertility modeling that allows reflecting the effect of demographic policies on the age-specific birth rates is presented. Reproduction is considered as a dynamic system with its inputs and outputs. The reaction of the age-specific birth rates to a set of demographic policies is considered as transient response. The latter can be used to predict the natality dynamics. Short-term and long-term predictions are reported, the former proved to be quite reliable.

articleTitle: New Properties of Stock Management Strategies and Their Interpretation
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Results of simulation modeling of stationary stock management strategies using the advanced software package in the MATHLAB environment under conditions of random disturbances and taking into account the unreliability of suppliers. The obtained results allow to reveal some unexpected properties of optimal stationary strategies and to give them a theoretical justification.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Classification Approach to Developing a Medical Diagnosis Based on the Results of Prepared Tests
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A formal procedure is proposed for making a medical diagnosis based on the results of analyzes that satisfy the specified requirements: for each type of possible disease, a set of analizes is formed, and in each such set the analyzes are ranked by "importance" for this disease. Presentation is conducted on the example of a specific sample of Dermatology from the known repository of UCI Machine Learning. The results indicate that the proposed procedure may be a useful medical assistant in making a definitive diagnosis.

articleTitle: On the Issue of Sectoral Structure of Investments in the Regions
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers some issues of the analysis of the sectoral structure of investments in the example of the North Caucasus Federal District in the period from 2010 to 2017.

articleTitle: Gradient Models of Geological Medium to Safety of Large-Scale Fuel-Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The zoning scheme for a large-scale fuel-energy system involving the natural gas wells and pipelines network can be made owing to the calculation of seismic gradient models coupled with modeling of a geographic cover of the being investigated land. This will give a possibility to outline places where the system functioning can be under risk because of the particular deep structure of the geological medium. On the other hand, such zoning can reveal the distinctive feature of subarea containing the gas deposit. The comparison of the results given by a novel algorithm and the basic technique of the gradient model computing is presented here.

articleTitle: Finite Dimensional Dynamics and Exact Solutions of Burgers – Huxley Equation
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Finite-dimensional lower-order dynamics are constructed for evolutionary differential equations generalizing the well-known Burgers - Huxley equation. These dynamics allow us to construct exact solutions to such equations. Some of them are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Modeling for Analysis of Infeasible Constraints of the Optimal Planning Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The article deals with the analysis of infeasible problems of optimal production planning of a large dimension. The properties of an infeasible task are formulated for a special linear programming problem. For this problem, the complexity of analyzing infeasible constraints increases linearly with increasing dimension. The data on the planning models of a number of refineries and the patterns of infeasible problems that are determined experimentally are given.

articleTitle: Electronic Medical Records as a Tool of a Large Hospital Management
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Possibility of studying electronic medical records (EMR) as a tool for managing a large hospital is being investigated. The criteria for the optimal operation of a large hospital based on an analysis of the place of large hospitals in the system of organization of medical care to the population. The requirements for a new generation of electronic medical records describe the methods of designing a large hospital management system.

articleTitle: Validation of Architectural Solutions within Implementation of Projects for Radioactive Waste Processing Mobile Facilities
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The features of creation of complex technical systems that are sources of potential radiation hazard have been considered. Regarding such systems, the relevance of applying the principles and approaches of system engineering, in particular, validation in the early stages of the life cycle, has been demonstrated. Methods and tools for the validation of architectural solutions which allow to minimize the risks of project implementation in compliance with the requirements for the system being developed have been proposed.

articleTitle: Formalization of Complex Objects with using the Expert Estimations
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: A method for formalizing a model of a complex object using expert data is proposed. A complex object is represented as a set of interacting components (factors). For numerical characteristics of individual interactions of components, the marks (ball estimates) are used, which, depending on the object of study, can be interpreted as the degree of risk, time, material resources, the degree of influence in the interaction of components. For each of these types of estimates the corresponding computational operations are applied. The results of the calculations are the estimates of the system response of the object under study to external influences. The process of counting forms a transitive closure of the primary estimates. In calculating of interaction degree, the multi-valued logic variables and operations are used. Examples of different ways of formalization are given.

articleTitle: Optimization of Development Strategies for Group of Gas Fields
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We consider the mathematical apparatus and software tools that ensure the formation of the best strategies for the development of a group of gas fields based on the joint use of simulation modeling, grid methods, discrete and multicriteria optimization.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic Parameters Identification of the Nanosatellite TNS-0 No 2 to Enhance Ballistic Calculations Precision for Low-Flying Satellites
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This report is devoted to an important problem of the space flight mechanics - the orbital motion analysis for the low-flying artificial Earth satellite with the goal to refine the parameters of the atmosphere to improve the prediction accuracy for the ballistic motion of orbital objects in the upper layers of the atmosphere.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Moments of Emergence and Collapse of Financial Bubbles by Algorithms of Current and Posteriori Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper proposes algorithms for detecting areas of explosive behavior of unsteady processes. We investigated two types: detection algorithms in the current mode and detection algorithms by historical data. Examples of bubble detection by historical data and the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of algorithms.

Author Keywords: detection and dating of financial bubbles

articleTitle: Development of "Krebs Cycle" Concept Conformably to Change Management in Large-Scale Systems and Prospects of This Subject for Viable Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Structural analogue of Krebs biochemical cycle, reproduced in organizational practice and used as the basic scheme of management concept, allows to form and consistently implement an iterative chain of ontologies change of large-scale system and to develop complete range of management solutions.

articleTitle: Methods for Evaluating the Influence of Resource Potential on the Development of Economic Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of varying the specific direct costs of production by economic subjects is considered. An algorithm based on the inverse matrix method is proposed. The algorithm is constructed in such a way that for numerous calculations of the effects of variations, only a single inversion of the matrix is required. The approach allows us to investigate non-local variations of two types: specific direct costs for a given product for all economic subjects; they are for a given economic subject for all products.

articleTitle: Symmetry in Large-Scale Socio-Economic Systems and the Implications for Management
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper provides a methodology for identifying and analyzing group-theoretical symmetry in socio-economic applications. Symmetry is disclosed in the tasks of estimating contingent claims, the main hypotheses of financial markets, time series of stock indexes, including pre-crisis periods, the distribution of urban population, and the duration of historical periods. The connection of solutions based on symmetry is displayed, in particular, with the management of pension savings and migration flows, as well as with the "digital" transformation of people's life attitudes.

articleTitle: The Cluster Analysis Method as an Instrument for Selection of Securities in the Construction of an Investment Portfolio
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: In the paper are presented research results on the application of cluster analysis for the formation of a securities portfolio. There are identified features of cluster analysis applicating various indicators characterizing shares: share prices, share prices movement, and various market multipliers of issuers. It is shown the application possibility of cluster analysis in the Robo-Advisors' algorithm.

articleTitle: Control of Takeoff and Landing of the Multicopter in a Moving Robotic Container Without External Navigation Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of the movement of the quadcopter in long autonomous missions is discussed. The approaches are analyzed to the organization of its take-off, vehicle following, and landing into a robotic container, which combines the functions of transportation and recharging the battery. Based on the results of the study, structural schemes of multicopter and container functioning in the absence of external navigation systems are suggested. Experimental realization of the visual tracking algorithms confirms the applicability of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Algorithms of Expert-Statistical Data Processing in the Problems of Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Problem of creating decision support systems (DSS) under uncertainty is considered. In many applied problems the most adequate mathematical tool for analyzing the actions of the DSS in the face of uncertainty are expert-statistical methods of information processing. The focus is on how to improve the reliability of the work of the DSS. A special test bench designed to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Equilibrium State and Coalition Stability of Interregional Economic Systems: Impact of Openness
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: new instrumental concepts for a class of optimization interregional input-output models are presented to study interdependence of three key features of the interregional system: equilibrium state, coalition stability and openness. A series of estimates was made that illustrates fundamental differences in the properties of a closed and open interregional system.

articleTitle: Regional Aspects of Monitoring in Managing the Development of National Economic Security
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: This article presents an approach that will allow regional authorities to effectively monitor the current state of regional development and the economic security of the region, to identify the most significant indicators that require special attention from a variety of socio-economic indicators, as well as to predict economic security in various areas in the medium term.

articleTitle: Methodological Aspects of Territorially Dispersed Clusters Functionality Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Addressing the combination of features and properties, characterizing technical systems, and various factors and effects that influence the functionality of technical objects. It is shown that for territorially dispersed clusters functionality analysis, it is necessary to take into account external adverse effects and requires the use of probabilistic models, complemented by principles of the situation-based approach to searching the most crucial objects and revealing the most damaging effects.

articleTitle: Onboard Support System for Decentralized Air Traffic Control
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Basic functions of onboard support systems for decentralized air traffic control are described. These functions are the detection and prevention of conflict situations in airspace and the planning of aircraft landing in automatic mode.

articleTitle: Controlled Coherent Effects in Monitoring Processes of Liquid Media
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with controlled coherent effects that are realized by modulating the radiation phase. It is shown that in this way it is possible to compensate for interference and increase the sensitivity of the methods.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Scheduling a Flight of a Group of Aircraft to Implement an Optimal Landing Plan
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The report discusses the formulation of the task scheduling the flight of a group of aircraft for the implementation of the optimal landing plan and proposes an algorithm for its solution.

articleTitle: Functions and Modes of Information Development of Economy
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of the research is determination of the efficiency of information and the modes of economic systems information development. The research methodology is formed by the classification method that allows us to highlight the properties of information, enter quantitative indicators for measuring these properties and compiling possible mathematical relationships between them - models of information dynamics with the graphical representation. There are introduced criterion of the economic system information potential and the efficiency of information, which is defined as the ratio of information security to the level of the information fullness of the system. The result of the study according to the introduced indicators measuring information properties is the selection of modes of economy information development, as well as the proposal of three options of cumulating information (knowledge) with the possibility of quantifying this effect, which determines the development of the knowledge sphere.

articleTitle: Relay Control for Inverted Pendulum with Cart under Influence Dry Friction Force
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of control of an inverted pendulum mounted on a movable cart. The cart can be moved along a guide rail. There is a dry friction force between the cart and the rail, and this force can be regulated by springs which are included in the construction of the cart. The control goal is stabilization of the pendulum in the upper position with the prescribed position of the cart on the guide rail. There is a problem of compensation the substantial nonlinear disturbance (dry friction force). The article is devoted to a new relay control law synthesis, which helps to attenuate the perturbation and solve the mentioned problem with the given accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control of a Free Flying Space Manipulation Robot in the Working Area when Assembling a Large Space Structure in Orbit
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The operation of the space manipulation robot in the free drift mode during the installation of the part when assembling a large space structure in space is considered. The analysis of the mathematical model of plane motion with the manipulative functioning of the robot in the working area is presented. The region of stability on the plane is determined in the coordinates of the hinge angles of the links of the manipulator, which allows us to distinguish the ranges of these angles at which the movement of the robot becomes unstable. This circumstance is taken into account when synthesizing adaptive control algorithms.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Probable Change of Investor’s Reputation Resulted from Megaproject Implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The research paper grounds the necessity of quantitative evaluation of a probable change in investor's reputation due to megaproject preparation and implementation. The authors suggest an evaluation method therefore and propose a game-theoretic model to estimate the values of weight numbers for the created model of evaluation of a probable change in investor's reputation resulted from megaproject implementation.

articleTitle: Link Analysis Between Objects in Object-Associated Electronic Document Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The organization of links between documents in electronic document management systems is considered. It is shown that during the modification to the systems of objectassociated document management systems, mutual connectivity in the system increases and implicit relationships between objects are manifested, which allow for an in-depth analysis of the process of combining objects.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Regional Development: Human Potential and Self-Identification
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Using the "passive experiment", a steady dependence of the value of the specific regional gross domestic product on the population density for the three existing groups of German regions was reveal. It is shown that reliance on hidden intangible assets, due to historically established positive self-identification, makes it possible to significantly accelerate the socio-economic development of the region.

articleTitle: Features of the Flowing Parts of CCGT’s Steam Turbine Thermal State Modelling when Operating in the Motor Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: When modeling and calculating the temperature of the compartments and groups of stages of the steam turbine takes into account the characteristics of the motor regime - influence of flow rate and parameters of the cooling steam and the steam coming from the end seals in hydraulics; distribution of steam pressure between the compartments and stages; heat exchange between the steam stages and the outside air. The calculated expressions and the algorithm for calculating the steam temperature in the control sections of the turbine are given, the influence of the proposed refinements on the temperature state is estimated.

articleTitle: Probabilistic-Entropic Conception of Sustainable Development of Regional Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The sustainable development problems of complex systems is considered. The sustainable development concept of systems for example with territories is proposed. In accordance with the concept the sustainable development is interpreted by vector entropic model whereas sustainability is accepted as risk of the investigated multidimensional system. The concept is tried out by means of practical examples.

articleTitle: Placement Replicas of Interrelated Data Arrays in Unreliable Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of optimal placement of replicas of interconnected data sets in a distributed data processing system is considered in the article. Communication channels of the distributed system are not reliable. The criterion for optimizing the task is the minimum of the average system response time to requests for data. A heuristic algorithm is proposed for the task solution.

Author Keywords: optimal placement of replicas of data array

articleTitle: Methodical Principles of Solving the Task of Placement and Development Classification Yards of the Railway Network in Conditions of Uncertainty of Perspective Traffic
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The purpose of the research is the development of scientific and methodological solutions in the field of placement and development of classification yards in conditions of uncertainty of prospective car traffic. Methodical principles for solving the problem are formulated using network traffic models, methods of decision theory and principles of robust control.

Author Keywords: placement and development of classification yards

articleTitle: Risk Management in Hierarchical Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Two hierarchical games with random factors are studied, in which the top-level player, besides choosing his control, also chooses an acceptable degree of risk. The definition of the maximum guaranteed result under the assumption of the benevolence of the lower-level player is given and analyzed. Three substantive interpretations of the studied models are proposed.

Author Keywords: maximum guaranteed result in the game with a benevolent player

articleTitle: Control of Terrestrial Transport by Means of Autonomous Radar Positioning
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Effective management of terrestrial transport in controlled and unmanned mode is impossible without its accurate and continuous positioning. The paper considers the possibility of increasing this accuracy in the absence or uncertain reception of signals from the satellites of the global navigation system. However, the use of an additional autonomous inertial system to solve this problem in this case is not justified for reasons of accuracy and cost. Therefore, a solution based on radar Doppler sensors as an alternative autonomous navigation system is proposed. Methods for measuring the speed vector and an algorithm for direct continuous measurement of displacements are considered. It is shown that the last measurement option can significantly reduce the cumulative error in the positioning of vehicles.

articleTitle: Application of the Modified Method S and F Approximations for the Study of Density Anomalies Under Hellas Planitia
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: We use modified method S and F approximations for the study of density anomalies under Hellas Planitia. We have calculated different models of anomalous masses locations beneath the Hellas Planitia region.

articleTitle: The Estimates of Stress State Beneath the Area of the Insight Landing Site on Mars
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Calculations of tension-compression and maximum shear stresses are carried out for a test model of Martian internal structure, which satisfy all today's geophysical and geochemical data. Spatial distribution of stresses under the InSight landing site is presented. We find that the areas of maximum extensional stresses along with high shear stresses are located to the East from the landing site.

articleTitle: Instruments of Configuration Management in Nuclear Power Plant Projects
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The description of configuration management instruments in nuclear power plant projects is given. The recommendations of the IAEA and ISO documents on development and usage of configuration management instruments are considered and the analysis of these recommendations implementation is carried out.

articleTitle: Theoretical Foundation of Information Waves Investigation in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Approaches to the investigation of events in the information space are mainly developed by mathematicians, who pay insufficient attention to the theoretical component of the problem. The article provides a rationale for the theoretical and methodological approach to the investigation of information processes from social sciences. Two key concepts of the information space are considered: an informational event as the focus of the process and informational waves as a mechanism for creating events.

articleTitle: The Necessary and Sufficient Condition of Portfolio Optimality on CC-VaR in Combined Markets
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: The work investigates peculiarities of using continuous VaR-criterion (CC-VaR) for a set of financial markets of different dimensions, which are partially mutually connected by their underliers. In a typical model case of a combination of a two-dimensional market and two related one-dimensional markets, a rule of constructing a combined portfolio in this market's collection is submitted. This rule gives a necessary and sufficient condition of portfolio optimality in the composition of basis instruments collection. The condition is based on misbalances in markets return relative with maintaining optimality in CC-VaR. Optimization algorithms are based on the Newman-Pearson procedure. Illustrative examples with diagrams of optimal portfolios returns are adduced.

articleTitle: Observation Subsystem Design for an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Under Undefined External Actions
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: As part of the synthesis of a tracking system for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) under the action of external uncontrolled disturbances and incomplete measurements of the state vector, the structure of the observation subsystem, which includes two state observers, was developed. The first observer gives estimates of the velocities based on measurements of the UAV mass center coordinates. The second observer on the measurement of tracking errors gives estimates of mixed variables (functions of state variables, external influences and their derivatives) for which feedback is formed.

articleTitle: Towards Global Energy Interconnection: Concept, Technologies, Challenges
publicationTitle: 2019 Twelfth International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD)
abstract: Objective trends of electric power systems interconnection will lead to the creation of Global Energy Interconnection (GEI). The concept of GEI is discussed. Future Euro-Asian electric power super pool will play a key role in the GEI. Unified Energy System (UES) of Russia should have an important integrating position in this super interconnection. The requirements for the development of UES of Russia are presented.
